name: ShortcutProvider
signature: export function ShortcutProvider({ children }: ShortcutProviderProps)

name: useAbortController
signature: export function useAbortController(): UseAbortControllerReturn
description:
Manage an `AbortController` tied to a component's lifecycle.

The controller is automatically aborted on unmount. Use `reset()` to
replace the current controller (aborting the previous one) and `abort()`
to cancel the current one in place.

name: useAnnouncer
signature: export function useAnnouncer(): AnnouncerApi
description:
Announce dynamic messages to assistive tech via a shared `aria-live` region.
Creates two hidden regions (polite + assertive) once per page and reuses them.

name: useAsync
signature: export function useAsync<T, A extends unknown[] = []>( fn: (...args: A) => Promise<T> ): UseAsyncReturn<T, A>
description:
Manage an async function's lifecycle — pending / success / error.
`run()` returns the resolved value (or undefined if cancelled by unmount).
Stale results are discarded after unmount.

name: useAsyncCallback
signature: export function useAsyncCallback<T, A extends unknown[] = []>( fn: (...args: A) => Promise<T> ): UseAsyncReturn<T, A>
description: Alias of `useAsync` — use whichever name reads better at the call site.

name: useClickOutside
signature: export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>( onClickOutside: () => void ): RefObject<T>
description:
Detect clicks outside a ref'd element.

@returns A ref to attach to the element whose outside-clicks you want to detect.

name: useClipboardRead
signature: export function useClipboardRead(): UseClipboardReadReturn
description: Read from the clipboard. Manages loading/error state.

name: useColorScheme
signature: export function useColorScheme( initial: ColorScheme = "system" ): UseColorSchemeReturn
description:
Manage color-scheme with "system" auto-resolution.

Does not persist — pair with `useLocalStorage` for that.

name: useControllableState
signature: export function useControllableState<T>(
description:
Controlled-or-uncontrolled state primitive.

- When `value` is provided, the component is controlled — internal state
  is ignored, and `onChange` is the only way to mutate.
- When `value` is undefined, the component is uncontrolled — internal
  state seeded from `defaultValue` is used, and `onChange` (if given)
  is still notified.

Dev-mode warns if a component switches between controlled and uncontrolled.

name: useCopyToClipboard
signature: export function useCopyToClipboard(resetDelay: number = 2000): UseCopyToClipboardReturn
description: Copy to clipboard with success state that auto-resets.

name: useCountdown
signature: export function useCountdown(
description: Live countdown to a future timestamp.

name: useDebounce
signature: export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number = 300): T
description: Debounce a value.

name: useDebouncedCallback
signature: export function useDebouncedCallback<A extends unknown[]>( fn: (...args: A) => void, delay: number ): DebouncedFn<A>
description:
Debounce a function. Calls are coalesced — only the last invocation within
`delay` ms runs (after the quiet window elapses).

The returned function has `.cancel()` and `.flush()` helpers; also cancelled
automatically on unmount.

name: useDerivedState
signature: export function useDerivedState<T>( derive: () => T, deps: readonly unknown[], isEqual: (prev: T, next: T) => boolean = Object.is ): T
description:
Derive state from dependencies with explicit equality checking.

Unlike `useMemo`, this stores the previous value and only triggers a
re-render when the derived value actually changes according to `isEqual`.

name: useDocumentTitle
signature: export function useDocumentTitle( title: string, options?: UseDocumentTitleOptions ): void
description:
Set the document title reactively.

Supports a `%s` template and optional restore-on-unmount.

name: useElementSize
signature: export function useElementSize<T extends Element>(ref: RefObject<T>): ResizeSize
description: Convenience wrapper over `useResizeObserver`.

name: useEscapeKey
signature: export function useEscapeKey( handler: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void, enabled: boolean = true ): void
description:
Fire `handler` when the user presses Escape.
Handler identity changes are tracked — no re-subscription per render.

name: useEvent
signature: export function useEvent<A extends unknown[], R>( fn: (...args: A) => R ): (...args: A) => R
description:
Stable callback ref that always sees the latest closure.
Implements the React `useEvent` RFC: the returned function's identity never
changes, but it always invokes the most-recent version of `fn`.

Use when passing a callback to deeply-memoized children or to effects with
restrictive dependency arrays.

name: useEventSource
signature: export function useEventSource( url: string | null, options: UseEventSourceOptions = {} ): UseEventSourceReturn

name: useFieldArray
signature: export function useFieldArray< TForm extends FormValues, TKey extends keyof TForm & string, TItem = TForm[TKey] extends Array<infer U> ? U : never, >( form: UseFormReturn<TForm>, name: TKey ): UseFieldArrayReturn<TItem>

name: useFocus
signature: export function useFocus(): UseFocusReturn
description: Track focus state. Spread `bind` onto the target element.

name: useFocusReturn
signature: export function useFocusReturn(enabled: boolean = true): void
description:
Save the element that had focus when this hook first runs, and restore focus
to it on unmount. Used by overlays (Modal, Drawer, Popover) for a11y:
the user's focus returns to the trigger after the overlay closes.

@param enabled Skip save/restore when false (for cleanly-dismounted overlays
  that shouldn't restore — e.g. when the trigger itself was removed).

name: useFocusVisible
signature: export function useFocusVisible(): boolean
description:
Global `:focus-visible` state: `true` when the last interaction was keyboard
(or programmatic), `false` for mouse/touch. Matches browser `:focus-visible`.

Subscribe once — the state is shared via bubbling DOM events.

name: useFocusWithin
signature: export function useFocusWithin<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>): boolean
description: `true` when any descendant of the element has focus.

name: useForceUpdate
signature: export function useForceUpdate(): () => void
description: Force re-render.

name: useForm
signature: export function useForm<T extends Record<string, unknown>>( options: UseFormOptions<T> ): UseFormReturn<T>

name: useFullscreen
signature: export function useFullscreen( ref?: RefObject<Element | null> ): UseFullscreenReturn
description: Enter, exit, and toggle fullscreen mode.

name: useGeolocation
signature: export function useGeolocation( options: UseGeolocationOptions = {} ): GeolocationState

name: useHasMounted
signature: export function useHasMounted(): boolean
description:
Returns `false` during the first render, `true` after mount.
Use to gate client-only content and avoid SSR hydration mismatches.

name: useHistoryState
signature: export function useHistoryState<T>( initialState: T, key: string = "__historyState" ): UseHistoryStateReturn<T>
description:
Sync React state with the browser History API.

State is namespaced under `key` inside `history.state` to avoid conflicts.
SSR-safe — returns `initialState` and all methods are no-ops on the server.

name: useHover
signature: export function useHover(): UseHoverReturn
description: Track hover state. Spread `bind` onto the target element.

name: useId
signature: export function useId(providedId?: string, prefix: string = "vf"): string

name: useIdle
signature: export function useIdle(timeout: number): boolean
description: `true` when the user has been idle (no input events) for `timeout` ms.

name: useIntersectionObserver
signature: export function useIntersectionObserver<T extends Element>( ref: RefObject<T>, options: UseIntersectionOptions = {} ): IntersectionState
description: Observe element intersection with the viewport (or a custom root).

name: useInterval
signature: export function useInterval(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void
description:
Repeating interval with cleanup.
@param delay `null` to pause.

name: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
signature: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== "undefined" ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect
description:
`useLayoutEffect` on the client, `useEffect` on the server.

Use in any hook that measures DOM (positioning, scroll, resize) so SSR
doesn't print `useLayoutEffect does nothing on the server` warnings.

name: useKeyboardShortcut
signature: export function useKeyboardShortcut( key: string, handler: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void, modifiers: KeyModifiers = {} ): void
description: Register a global keyboard shortcut.

name: useKeyPress
signature: export function useKeyPress(key: string): boolean
description: `true` while `key` (KeyboardEvent.key, case-insensitive) is pressed.

name: useList
signature: export function useList<T>(initialList?: T[]): UseListReturn<T>

name: useLocalStorage
signature: export function useLocalStorage<T>( key: string, initialValue: T ): [T, (value: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]
description: Persist state in localStorage.

name: useLockBodyScroll
signature: export function useLockBodyScroll(locked: boolean = true): void
description:
Lock body scroll by setting `overflow: hidden` on `document.body`.
Restores original overflow on unlock or unmount. SSR-safe.

name: useLongPress
signature: export function useLongPress( handler: (e: ReactPointerEvent) => void, { threshold = 500, onCancel }: UseLongPressOptions = {} ): LongPressBindings
description: Long-press detection. Returns bindings to spread onto the target element.

name: useMap
signature: export function useMap<K, V>( initialEntries?: Iterable<[K, V]> ): UseMapReturn<K, V>

name: useMediaQuery
signature: export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean
description:
Responsive media query hook.
@param query e.g. `"(max-width: 768px)"`

name: useMergedRefs
signature: export function useMergedRefs<T>( ...refs: Array<Ref<T> | undefined | null> ): RefCallback<T>

name: useMountEffect
signature: export function useMountEffect(effect: EffectCallback): void
description:
Runs `effect` once when the component mounts. Cleanup runs on unmount.
Equivalent to `useEffect(fn, [])` but communicates intent.

name: useMutationObserver
signature: export function useMutationObserver( ref: RefObject<Element | null>, callback: MutationCallback, options?: MutationObserverInit ): void
description:
Observe DOM mutations on a ref'd element.

Uses `useRef` to store the latest callback so the observer
doesn't need to be re-created on every render.

name: useNetworkStatus
signature: export function useNetworkStatus(): NetworkStatus
description:
`{ online, downlink?, effectiveType? }`. Reacts to `online`/`offline` events
and (where supported) `navigator.connection` changes.

name: useOnlineStatus
signature: export function useOnlineStatus(): NetworkInfo
description:
Track online/offline status and network quality via the Network Information API.
SSR-safe: returns `{ online: true }` on the server.

name: useOrientation
signature: export function useOrientation(): OrientationState
description:
Track device orientation via the Screen Orientation API.

Falls back to comparing `innerWidth`/`innerHeight` when the API is
unavailable. SSR-safe — returns portrait defaults with `isSupported: false`.

name: usePageVisibility
signature: export function usePageVisibility(): PageVisibility
description: `document.visibilityState` reactive. Returns `"visible"` on the server.

name: usePermission
signature: export function usePermission(name: PermissionName): UsePermissionReturn

name: usePreferredLanguage
signature: export function usePreferredLanguage(): PreferredLanguage
description:
Track the user's preferred language(s) via `navigator.language`.

Listens for the `languagechange` event to stay in sync.
SSR-safe — defaults to `"en"`.

name: usePrefersColorScheme
signature: export function usePrefersColorScheme(): "dark" | "light"
description: `"dark" | "light"` — user's system preference. Returns `null` pre-match.

name: usePrefersReducedMotion
signature: export function usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean
description: `true` when the user has opted into reduced motion via OS settings.

name: usePrevious
signature: export function usePrevious<T>(value: T): T | undefined
description: Previous value of a variable (from last render).

name: useRafInterval
signature: export function useRafInterval(callback: () => void, ms: number | null = 0): void
description:
Repeating callback driven by `requestAnimationFrame`. Fires at most once
per `ms` milliseconds (defaults to every frame).

Use for scroll/animation loops where visual fidelity matters more than
timer precision. Pass `null` to pause.

name: useResizeObserver
signature: export function useResizeObserver<T extends Element>( ref: RefObject<T> ): ResizeSize
description:
Observe an element's content-box size.
Returns `{ width: 0, height: 0 }` until the first measurement.

name: useScroll
signature: export function useScroll(): ScrollPosition
description: Track window scroll position.

name: useScrollDirection
signature: export function useScrollDirection(
description:
Tracks whether the user is scrolling up or down.
Returns `null` until the first scroll event.

name: useScrollPosition
signature: export function useScrollPosition<T extends HTMLElement>( ref: RefObject<T> ): ScrollPos
description:
Track scroll position of a specific element (as opposed to `useScroll` which
tracks `window`). Returns `{ x: 0, y: 0 }` until first scroll event.

name: useSet
signature: export function useSet<T>(initialValues?: Iterable<T>): UseSetReturn<T>

name: useShortcut
signature: export function useShortcut( keys: string, handler: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void, options: UseShortcutOptions = {} ): void
description:
Register a keyboard shortcut. The handler runs at document-level keydown.
If a `ShortcutProvider` is in scope, the shortcut also shows up in
`ShortcutGuide`.

name: useShortcutRegistry
signature: export function useShortcutRegistry(): ShortcutRegistryValue | null

name: useStopwatch
signature: export function useStopwatch(
description: Elapsed-time stopwatch. Starts paused unless `autoStart` is true.

name: useThemePersistence
signature: export function useThemePersistence<T extends string = string>( options: UseThemePersistenceOptions<T> = {} ): UseThemePersistenceReturn<T>

name: useThrottle
signature: export function useThrottle<T>(value: T, interval: number): T
description: Throttle a value. The returned value updates at most once per `interval` ms.

name: useThrottledCallback
signature: export function useThrottledCallback<A extends unknown[]>( fn: (...args: A) => void, interval: number, options: { leading?: boolean; trailing?: boolean } = {} ): (...args: A) => void
description:
Throttle a function. Call at most once every `interval` ms.
Leading-edge: the first call fires immediately; subsequent calls within
the interval are dropped (or held as "trailing" — see `trailing`).

name: useTimeout
signature: export function useTimeout(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void
description:
Fire `callback` after `delay` ms. Pass `null` to pause.
Callback identity changes are handled — the ref is always kept current.

name: useToggle
signature: export function useToggle( initial: boolean = false, key?: string ): [boolean, () => void, Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>]

name: useUndoRedo
signature: export function useUndoRedo<T>( initialState: T, options?: UseUndoRedoOptions<T> ): UseUndoRedoReturn<T>
description: Undo/redo state management with history tracking.

name: useUnmountEffect
signature: export function useUnmountEffect(fn: () => void): void
description: Runs `fn` exactly once on unmount.

name: useUpdateEffect
signature: export function useUpdateEffect(effect: EffectCallback, deps?: DependencyList): void
description: Like `useEffect`, but skips the first render.

name: useWebSocket
signature: export function useWebSocket( url: string | null, options: UseWebSocketOptions = {} ): UseWebSocketReturn

name: useWindowSize
signature: export function useWindowSize(): WindowSize
description: Track window dimensions.
